title: I miss playing with my friends and raiding, So started building this. \o/
author: Dowee2
selftext:
![video](rqwl158f7s3i1 "In the video, the 3rd clip you see with the tank is the all-AI party afterwards. The split-screen parts are my girlfriend and me on one screen.")

Since July 14th i've been working on Project Trinity: Shatterbound a hub-based dungeon crawler built around the Holy Trinity, like in MMORPGs: a tank, a healer, and DPS. It takes some influence from TERA, WoW, and Final Fantasy 14, the other  MMOs i grew up playing.  
  
Project Trinity is also the AI party, the tank, healer, and DPS that run with you. The goal was to make them extremely competent, like my own days chasing leaderboards, number ones, and day one clears. They're never throttled. The only thing I take away is knowledge, and only where it helps with the raid leader fantasy and the dungeon raiding fantasy. I just tell it less. Along with that, you can swap characters mid-fight: one second you're tanking, the next you're the healer.



https://reddit.com/link/1y5bz4y/video/m3q28qif9s3i1/player

Claude/Codex built the world you're looking at. So far, dungeons and set pieces were made by Claude/Codex, by hand in Blender, and I "try" to clean up the textures after. Most of the main cast and some bosses are AI-generated. The animations, music, and sound effects are packs I bought (god bless Humble Bundle), and the voice lines are ElevenLabs.

I've been a software engineer for seven years, but surprisingly didn't have to write a single line of code for this. I architected the project, guided it, and gave my direction on how the game AI should play, how the bosses should play, and how everything should lay out. The orchestrators and integrators built it all out. It started with one integrator, then it grew, and it kept growing, and each time it grew, it came with me nuking the repo. Now it's one orchestrator and a seat for each job, each one working off a sheet with a line it has to knock off. 

![gif](yazfca26as3i1 "Almost threw me into AI psychosis")

![gif](ocjvlun7as3i1 "Not shown: I mainly speak with the orchestrator.")

What went wrong: at one point I had 12 seats up at once. Horrible time, don't ever do that xD. AI will defend itself too, but that doesn't mean it's always right, and it doesn't mean it's wrong either. You might just have an angle it's not looking at. 

What surprised me, first: AI can't hear, and it can't really see motion, it only sees frames. So be prepared. If you're going to build something, you'll be listening to a lot of audio and music and watching a lot of recordings and clips. I highly recommend asking them to build a workspace for you based on your games flow and your preferences.

https://i.redd.it/hfec52rgas3i1.jpeg

What also surprised me is how many devices it takes to run this game properly now. On my own I could do this on a laptop just fine, but with so much happening I have to split the work and the CI across so many devices. Even my ROG Ally is putting in work.

I built it mainly because I miss playing with my friends. TERA shut down, everybody's busy and in different time zones now, and some raid buddies of mine have died, so I can never really play with them again. So I've built some AI party members to help me. I ensured co-op could work so they could hop in at any time, but more importantly leave at any time without worrying about spoiling a dungeon because real life has become the most important now.

What I use:

* Claude/Codex codes the game in Unity (Unity MCP, Unity CLI) and builds the worlds in Blender: the world and what's in it, visual effects, meshes.
* Codex puts together the models in Blender and some visual effects.
* Gemini and Muse are new to the team: code review and secondary code review. .
* Tripo and Meshy for the generated models.
* AWS for cloud simulations of the sim and training, because this is half research and game development: a machine learning project and a game built at once.



tldr: I'm burning up half the ocean all to build  3D action combat dungeon/raid crawler. Where an AI tank, healer, and DPS fight beside you, and you and your friend(s) can swap into any of them mid-fight. AI agents wrote all the code; I designed, decided on, and played it. Still in its Alpha phase, the aim is all platforms

comments.author: No_Incident2835
comments.body: This is really amazing! How much time does it take you day to day?

replies.author: Dowee2
replies.body: Thank you! I've been really grinding on it for the past so about 10 hours a day or so after work on the really busy days. (0 when im out of usage, trying not to burn out xD)
